message.content: {"verdict": "revise", "score": 0.58, "reasons": ["The artifact is truncated and incomplete (last row ends with 'overall syste' and is not full CSV content).", "The first Li-ion row is missing a value for capital_cost_usd_per_kw.", "While there are multiple sources per technology, the CSV is not guaranteed to parse cleanly due to truncation and potential line breaks; the final file as-is does not represent a complete market_research.csv.", "Some cells mix units in the opex column (e.g., '$5-20 per kW-yr (typical range)' vs 'opex highly variable; example ... $/kW-yr not standardized') which could violate the 'specify units' requirement if not standardized across all rows.", "The last two rows for Thermal energy storage are split across lines and one ends mid-sentence ('overall syste'), indicating truncation and incomplete data."], "guidance": "Produce a complete market_research.csv that: 1) includes a filled capital_cost_usd_per_kw for every Li-ion row (and all other rows), using credible ranges from the cited sources; 2) ensures observation_date is present for every row and falls within the requested recency (preferably last 5 years, with 2021-2024 acceptable); 3) fixes the truncated ending (complete the final NREL entry and any other incomplete lines) so the file is a valid, parseable CSV; 4) maintains at least 2 authoritative sources per major technology and clearly labels opex units (consistent across the file, e.g., per kW-yr or per MWh-yr for all rows); 5) saves exactly as market_research.csv and includes all requested columns in the specified order; 6) includes explicit range values where applicable and keeps notes concise and source-backed. If any row cannot be reasonably completed with credible data, either remove it or replace with a clearly sourced alternative that meets the same columns and constraints."}
